locations.result: Read Entire composite action, inputs and outputs; src/main.ts command registration; src/runCodexExec.ts:255-355; package.json. The composite action installs only Codex and its Responses proxy, runs one codex exec process on the selected runner, and returns a final message. Its helper CLI has action setup/run commands. Inspection of action.yml and src found no desktop/browser/mobile client, harness adapter, agent delegation controller, task database, shared-prompt server, SSO, diff viewer, PR creation, worktree/container/VM provisioning or action telemetry toggle. GitHub supplies workflow control and permissions; Codex internals are separate.
Read Concurrency: default behavior. GitHub Actions permits jobs and multiple instances of a workflow to run concurrently by default; caller concurrency settings and runner quotas can restrict this.
Reviewed latest returned release records: . Older pinned implementation findings retain their scope.
